# Shipcast

Shipcast turns your git log into a two-minute changelog podcast.

Point it at a repo, pick a host voice, and every merged pull request becomes a
spoken episode your users can actually follow.

## Why

- Release notes nobody reads become episodes people finish.
- Generates an episode from 500 commits in under 40 seconds.
- Works with GitHub, GitLab, and plain `git`.

## Install

```sh
npx shipcast init
```
